Our Background


Gourmet Garden has everything to do with fresh flavor - and nothing to do with fuss. Garlic without garlicky fingers. Ginger sans peeling and chopping. Cilantro that lasts up to four weeks in the fridge! All pre-washed, pre-chopped and no wilt guilt.
